description: This file defines the 'testcase' class for managing test case entities in the TestLink open-source test management tool. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving test cases and their versions, as well as handling related entities such as steps, keywords, and attachments. The class interacts with the database and integrates with the larger TestLink framework, incorporating event signals and configuration management.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class encapsulating the logic for handling test cases within the TestLink framework, including CRUD operations, version management, attachment handling, and related functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the testcase object with database connection, configuration, and related managers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test case with specified attributes, handling duplicates and naming conventions.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the specified attributes of a test case and its version, including steps, keywords, and other properties.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test case and its related versions and artifacts from the database.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves test cases matching a given name, with options for filtering by test suite and project.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Returns an array with all test cases in the system.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a test case, including versions, steps, keywords, attachments, and relations.

methods.name: createFromObject
methods.description: Creates a test case object from a given data object, optionally setting its status.

methods.name: setTestProject
methods.description: Associates the test case with a specific test project.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name/title of a test case by its ID.

methods.name: getFileUploadRelativeURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for uploading files related to a specific test case version.

methods.name: getDeleteAttachmentRelativeURL
methods.description: Generates URL to delete an attachment for a test case version.

methods.name: getDeleteAttachmentByIDRelativeURL
methods.description: Builds URL to delete an attachment by its ID, optionally incorporating GUI context.

methods.name: getDeleteTCVRelationRelativeURL
methods.description: Creates URL for removing test case version relations.

methods.name: getDeleteTCVKeywordRelativeURL
methods.description: Creates URL for removing a keyword relation from a test case version.

methods.name: get_export_file_types
methods.description: Returns map of supported export file types.

methods.name: get_import_file_types
methods.description: Returns map of supported import file types.

methods.name: get_execution_types
methods.description: Returns map of available execution types.

methods.name: getDuplicatesByName
methods.description: Finds duplicate test cases with the same name under a parent node.

methods.name: check_link_and_exec_status
methods.description: Checks if a test case is linked to test plans and if it has been executed.

methods.name: get_executions
methods.description: Retrieves execution data for a specific test case version, including details like status, tester info, build, platform, and execution timestamps.

methods.name: get_last_execution
methods.description: Fetches information about the most recent execution of a test case version, with details similar to get_executions but focused on the latest run.

methods.name: exportTestCaseDataToXML
methods.description: Exports comprehensive test case data, including steps, keywords, requirements, attachments, and relations to XML format for external use or backup.

methods.name: get_version_exec_assignment
methods.description: Retrieves user assignment information for executing a specific test case version within a test plan.

methods.name: get_assigned_to_user
methods.description: Returns a map of test case versions assigned to a particular user within specific test plans and projects, with options for full path or filtering.

methods.name: update_active_status
methods.description: Enables or disables a test case version by updating its 'active' status.

methods.name: update_order
methods.description: Changes the order of a test case within its hierarchy or test suite.

methods.name: update_external_id
methods.description: Sets or updates the external identifier for a test case, with updates cascading to associated nodes.

methods.name: copy_attachments
methods.description: Copies all attachments from one test case to another.

methods.name: copyReqAssignmentTo
methods.description: Copies requirement assignments from one test case to another, optionally mapping IDs when test cases belong to different projects.

methods.name: getShowViewerActions
methods.description: Provides permissions and action flags for viewing and editing test cases based on mode.

methods.name: deleteExecution
methods.description: Deletes a specific execution entry and related bug, value, and execution data from database tables.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_design
methods.description: Retrieves linked custom fields applicable during test case design, typically at creation or editing time.

methods.name: getTestProjectFromTestCase
methods.description: Determines the test project ID associated with a test case, based on its path in the hierarchy.

methods.name: get_testproject
methods.description: Returns the test project ID to which a given test case belongs.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML form inputs for custom fields linked to a test case, used in design/editing interfaces.

methods.name: htmlTableOfCFValues
methods.description: Wrapper for rendering read-only custom field values as an HTML table, given a context.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Produces an HTML table displaying custom fields and their values for a test case or version.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_execution
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields linked to a test case during execution, including current values.

methods.name: copy_cfields_design_values
methods.description: Copies custom field values from a source test case to a destination test case.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_testplan_design
methods.description: Fetches custom fields linked to test plan design, for use during test plan creation or modification.

methods.name: buildCFLocationMap
methods.description: Builds a map of custom field locations, used for UI placement and identification.

methods.name: getPathLayered
methods.description: Returns a hierarchical map of test suites leading to specified test cases, including optional keyword data.

methods.name: getPathTopSuite
methods.description: Retrieves top-level suite information for a set of test cases, including suite name and ID.

methods.name: getByPathName
methods.description: Locates a test case by its hierarchical pathname, if it exists.

methods.name: buildDirectWebLink
methods.description: Constructs a direct URL link to a test case using external identifiers and test project prefix.

methods.name: getExternalID
methods.description: Generates an external identifier for a test case, combining project prefix and internal external ID.

methods.name: get_basic_info
methods.description: Fetches basic info (name, version, external ID) for a test case, typically for user display.
